summary: Sprint 0B Phase 1 'New Property Workspace' PASSED end-to-end. All 17 requested UI/integration checks pass with zero console errors and zero page errors. Navigation, header actions, live Vera insights, operation toggle, description generation, photo drag&drop pipeline (5 stages ~4.5s), detected rooms, cover badge, save/draft/cancel toasts, back arrow — all working per spec.
critical_code_review_comments: PropertyWorkspace.tsx: form.watch() returns a new object each render; the useMemo deps depend on `values` (whole object) so assistantService.analyze is recomputed on every keystroke — fine at current scale but consider memoizing with individual watched fields if the form grows.

useVeraStudio.ts: URL.createObjectURL blob URLs are revoked only on removePhoto, not on unmount/route change — minor memory leak if user navigates away with photos loaded. Consider a cleanup useEffect that revokes all URLs on unmount.

useVeraStudio.ts: countRef captures photos.length via useEffect and is used inside runProcessing to determine analysis size — works because addFiles enqueues state update then triggers runProcessing, but the ref only updates after render. If user drops files twice quickly, second run may analyze stale count. Consider passing count into runProcessing explicitly.
DescriptionSection: character counter shows description.trim().length which is fine; would be nice to color it green once >=120 to reinforce the recommendation gating.

assistant-service.ts checks include `!!values.type` (always true because defaultPropertyForm.type='departamento') — that's why initial quality is 13% (1/8). Consider excluding the always-preset field from the score, or making `type` a required blank select, so the score reflects real user progress from 0%.
form-schema.ts: price/bedrooms/bathrooms/areaM2 typed as string. Fine for the mock but will need z.coerce.number() + validation when persistence lands.
No visible aria-live region on .vera-toast (only role='status') — VoiceOver announces it, but adding aria-live='polite' would be more explicit for screen readers.
seed_data_creation: Created 6 tiny 1x1 PNG files in /tmp/vera_test_imgs/ to feed the hidden [data-testid=photo-file-input] via set_input_files.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sprint 0B Phase 1 workspace at /propiedades/nueva is fully green. Test URL: https://real-estate-os-10.preview.emergentagent.com/propiedades/nueva. To exercise the photo pipeline, upload real image files via page.set_input_files('[data-testid=photo-file-input]', paths) and wait ~5.5s (5 stages x ~900ms). Initial quality is 13% (only 'type' preset from default form) — expected. All 5 stage ids: lighting, perspective, rooms, duplicates, cover. Toasts auto-hide after 2600ms, so wait ~2.8s between successive toast assertions. StudioService + VeraAssistantService are mock/deterministic.
